name: the-downloader
title: The Downloader
description: Download videos, audio, image galleries, Spotify music, and complete webpages from YouTube, Reddit, Spotify and more
author: Stheno

commands.name: index
commands.title: Download
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Download video, audio, galleries, webpages, or transcripts

commands.name: fast-download
commands.title: Fast Download
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Paste a URL and download it instantly using your saved defaults — no form.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Download History
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Browse, open and re-download everything you've downloaded with The Downloader.

commands.name: chat-link
commands.title: Chat About Link
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Paste a link — a video, a post or an article — and ask anything about it. Loads the details and the transcript, caption or article text, and answers with Raycast AI, Apple Intelligence or Ollama.

preferences.name: aiEngine
preferences.title: AI Engine
preferences.description: Which model answers in Chat About Link. Automatic uses Raycast AI when you have access, then Apple Intelligence on macOS 27, then a running Ollama.

preferences.name: raycastModel
preferences.title: Raycast AI Model
preferences.description: Model for Raycast AI answers. Default follows Raycast's own choice.

preferences.name: ollamaUrl
preferences.title: Ollama URL
preferences.description: Address of your Ollama server.

preferences.name: ollamaModel
preferences.title: Ollama Model
preferences.description: Model name, e.g. `llama3.2` or `qwen3:8b`. Leave blank to use the first installed model.

preferences.name: ollamaContext
preferences.title: Ollama Context Size
preferences.description: Context window (num_ctx) in tokens. Larger fits more of the transcript but needs more memory. Integer; default 8192.

preferences.name: transcriptLanguage
preferences.title: Transcript Language
preferences.description: Caption language to load, as a code like `en` or `de`. Auto uses the video's own language, then English.

preferences.name: chatImages
preferences.title: Look at Images
preferences.description: Whether Chat About Link lets the AI look at a post's images (up to 4). Only Apple Intelligence and Ollama vision models can; Raycast AI reads text only. Looking at images is slower.

tools.name: download-video
tools.title: Download Video
tools.description: Downloads a video from a given URL

tools.name: read-link
tools.title: Read Link
tools.description: Reads a link's details and its text — a video's transcript with [m:ss] timestamps, a social post's caption, or a web article — for summarizing or answering questions about what it says

tools.name: get-link-info
tools.title: Get Link Info
tools.description: Gets a link's details and statistics without its text: title, author or channel, site, date, views, likes, comments, engagement rates, chapters, tags, description, and a video's caption languages

preferences.name: downloadPath
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Where downloads are saved.

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromClipboard
preferences.title: Auto Load URL from Clipboard
preferences.description: When you open Download or Chat About Link, fill in a link you've copied.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromSelectedText
preferences.title: Auto Load URL from Selected Text
preferences.description: When you open Download, fill in a link from the text selected in the frontmost app.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: enableBrowserExtensionSupport
preferences.title: Browser Extension Support
preferences.description: Offer the current browser tab's link. Needs the Raycast browser extension.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: checkToolUpdates
preferences.title: Check for Tool Updates
preferences.description: Before a download, check whether the tools it uses (yt-dlp, gallery-dl, ffmpeg…) are outdated and offer to update them.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: videoMediaType
preferences.title: Video: Media Type
preferences.description: Default for video URLs: download the full video, or extract audio only.

preferences.name: videoQuality
preferences.title: Video: Quality
preferences.description: Default video resolution. Ignored when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: videoContainer
preferences.title: Video: Container
preferences.description: Default container for downloaded video. Ignored when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: audioFormat
preferences.title: Video: Audio Format
preferences.description: Default audio format when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: exactFormatSelection
preferences.title: Video: Exact Format Selection
preferences.description: Show an Exact Format field in the Download form for video downloads — every concrete yt-dlp format with its file size. Leave off for simple Quality + Container choices.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowser
preferences.title: Gallery: Cookies from Browser
preferences.description: Use your login from this browser for galleries and posts that need one (Instagram, Reddit…), in Download and Chat About Link.

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowserCustom
preferences.title: Gallery: Custom Browser Spec
preferences.description: Used when 'Cookies from Browser' is set to Custom. Pass a gallery-dl --cookies-from-browser spec, e.g. `firefox:/path/to/profile` or `chromium:C:\Users\…\User Data\Default`.

preferences.name: spotifyAudioFormat
preferences.title: Spotify: Audio Format
preferences.description: Default audio format for Spotify downloads.

preferences.name: spotifyClientId
preferences.title: Spotify: Client ID
preferences.description: Spotify Developer app Client ID. Required for reliable Spotify downloads — without it, spotDL's anonymous session frequently fails with 'Could not get session auth tokens'. See SPOTIFY.md for one-time setup.

preferences.name: spotifyClientSecret
preferences.title: Spotify: Client Secret
preferences.description: Spotify Developer app Client Secret. Pairs with Client ID above. Stored as a password.

preferences.name: spotifyUserAuth
preferences.title: Spotify: User Authentication
preferences.description: Enable browser-based OAuth so spotDL can read your private playlists and saved library. On the next Spotify download your browser opens once to authorize the Dev app on http://127.0.0.1:9900/, which must be registered as a Redirect URI on the app. See SPOTIFY.md.
preferences.label: Use browser OAuth for private content

preferences.name: webpageSaveMode
preferences.title: Webpage: Save Mode
preferences.description: Default for saved webpages. Complete embeds everything; Lightweight strips JavaScript.

preferences.name: networkIdleTimeoutSec
preferences.title: Advanced: Network Idle Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds a download may stay silent before it's treated as stuck and stopped. Raise it only on very slow connections. Default 120.

preferences.name: forceIpv4
preferences.title: Advanced: Force IPv4
preferences.description: Only if downloads fail on a network with broken IPv6: make yt-dlp use IPv4.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: homebrewPath
preferences.title: Advanced: Homebrew Path
preferences.description: macOS only. Leave empty unless Homebrew is somewhere unusual; `which brew` in Terminal shows where it is.

preferences.name: ytdlPath
preferences.title: Advanced: yt-dlp Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific yt-dlp. Leave empty to use the one The Downloader finds or installs. `which yt-dlp` in Terminal shows where yours is.

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: Advanced: FFmpeg Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific FFmpeg. Leave empty to use the one The Downloader finds or installs. `which ffmpeg` in Terminal shows where yours is.

preferences.name: ffprobePath
preferences.title: Advanced: FFprobe Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific FFprobe. Leave empty to use the one The Downloader finds or installs. `which ffprobe` in Terminal shows where yours is.

preferences.name: denoPath
preferences.title: Advanced: Deno Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific Deno. Leave empty to use the one The Downloader finds or installs. `which deno` in Terminal shows where yours is.

preferences.name: galleryDlPath
preferences.title: Advanced: gallery-dl Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific gallery-dl. Leave empty to use the one The Downloader finds or installs. `which gallery-dl` in Terminal shows where yours is.

preferences.name: spotDlPath
preferences.title: Advanced: spotDL Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific spotDL. Leave empty to use the copy The Downloader downloads. `which spotdl` in Terminal shows where yours is.

preferences.name: monolithPath
preferences.title: Advanced: Monolith Path
preferences.description: Only to use a specific Monolith. Leave empty to use the one The Downloader finds or installs. `which monolith` in Terminal shows where yours is.

ai.instructions: After downloading the video, always link the video with [<video title>](<download path>), so the user can easily open it. Use read-link to read what a link says (summaries, questions about the content) and get-link-info for how it is doing (views, likes, comments). When answering from a video's transcript, point to moments with their timestamp as a link, like [4:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID&t=245s), using the link format the tool output shows; for posts and articles there are no timestamps — name the source instead ("the post's caption", "the article"). Only state what the tool output supports. Reply in the user's language.

- Site: Instagram
- Published: 2026-09-10

mocks.read-link:
# NASA Awards Orbital Safety Analysis Support Services Contract

## Facts
- Author: Rob Garner
- URL: https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-awards-orbital-safety-analysis-support-services-contract/
- Site: NASA
- Reading time: 1 min

## Article text
NASA has awarded a contract to Omitron Inc. for the acquisition of orbital safety analysis services, which provide for critical protection of NASA's space assets.

This indefinite-delivery contract is valued at approximately $23.5 million over a five-year period of performance.

The work will take place at Omitron's location in Beltsville, Maryland, and at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.

expected.meetsCriteria: Summarizes the contract: Omitron, orbital safety analysis, about $23.5 million over five years; no video timestamps
